summary: Windows-first Electron kiosk for guided two-person live speech translation.
active_objective: Repository verification is passing after the Electron E2E visitor non-Latin flow fix.
assumptions: README and existing status entries are treated as claims to verify against code and commands.
The packaging audit task is chosen because higher-priority residual tasks require real Windows target hardware or live provider credentials.
decisions: Audit artifacts will be written at repository root as AUDIT_CRITICO.md, APP_FLOW.md, AUDIT_FINDINGS.json, and AUDIT_ACTION_PLAN.md.
Packaging audit should treat zero npm audit vulnerabilities as a passing release gate state instead of requiring stale known findings.
next_tasks: Validate packaged activation and commissioning on real Windows target hardware.
Validate live provider speech end-to-end with real credentials, microphone input, and playback.
Validate packaged autostart via HKCU Run key at real Windows logon.
risks: Live provider, hardware, installer upgrade, rollback, and accessibility claims cannot be fully proven from static repository checks alone.
Existing local .env is present and must not be disclosed in audit outputs.
Provider secrets are currently passed to Electron renderers for parts of STT/TTS flow.

runtime: Ollama-compatible HTTP API for translation diagnostics/demo

last_completed_work: Fixed the Electron automation inspector for the Station B non-Latin visitor session proof and verified npm run verify:repo -- -KeepOutputs -EnablePackagedAutomation.
open_questions: Which runtime mode and provider combination is considered the production default for customer deployments?
What exact hardware/display/microphone matrix is contractually supported?
Is the Electron renderer intended to be trusted enough to receive provider secrets?
Should REQUIRED_MICROPHONES be a hard runtime constraint?
handoff_notes: Audit artifacts are present at repository root. npm run test:e2e, npm test, and npm run verify:repo -- -KeepOutputs -EnablePackagedAutomation passed on 2026-05-13. The full repository gate produced retained package, release evidence, notices, and SBOM artifacts under artifacts/. Doctor still warns that configured display and microphone IDs are not currently available on this workstation; real hardware/provider validations remain open.
